notes:
Nashama TV iOS v1.1.10 (important fix):
- Fixed live/movie/episode playback not working at all. A previous latency optimization disabled AVPlayer's built-in buffering safety net, which could leave the player stuck showing nothing. Reverted -- playback should work reliably again.
- Settings: added a working Check for Update button; removed the non-functional Parental Lock PIN and Restore Hidden Categories entries.
- Attempted fix for channel/poster logos rendering as gray placeholders (image requests now send the same User-Agent header stream playback uses).
- Install with Sideloadly or xtool using your Apple ID; re-sideload every 7 days to keep it signed.
